noSavedArticlesDescription: Long press an article in the feed or double tap an article in the card view to save it to your list.

hint1Description: RSS Scroll is an app that displays the latest articles from your subscribed RSS feeds in a card format. Tap an article to read the full content on the original website. Add RSS feed URLs in the Settings tab to customize the app to your preferences.
hint1Summary: Welcome to RSS Scroll! This app displays RSS feeds in a short and engaging card format. Add your RSS feed URLs in the Settings tab.
hint2Description: In the Feed tab, you can browse the latest articles from your added RSS feeds.
hint2Summary: In the Feed tab, you can browse the latest articles from your added RSS feeds. Tap any article to view its details.
hint3Description: In the Settings tab, you can add or remove RSS feed URLs and configure other settings.
hint3Summary: In the Settings tab, you can add or remove RSS feed URLs and configure other settings. You can also check the app version information here.
autoScrollHint: The articles will automatically advance every 5 seconds. Long press an article to open the settings.
noNewArticlesMessage: There are no new articles, so we are showing already viewed articles.
allArticlesDisplayedDescription: All articles are displayed. Please wait until new articles are added.
allArticlesDisplayedSummary: Please wait until new articles are added.
